_comment: THE DEVICE GATE'S PRECONDITIONS, in machine-readable form.
STANDING ORDER (Rafe, 2026-09-03): no build installs to the phone unless, ON THAT EXACT
BUILD, all four hold. Rafe's walk is the LAST gate, not the first working one.
This file is the declared state and tools/tier0_harness/gate_precheck.py is the enforcement.
build_review_app.sh calls it and REFUSES TO INSTALL if it fails. A rule that depends on my
restraint is not a rule — this session has proved that twice — so the rule lives in the
build path rather than in an intention.
A build announcement missing any of the four is itself a defect, so the precheck prints them
and the announcement quotes its output.
_approved_capture_note: ⚠ BLOCKING, AND THE GAP IS REAL RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT OF THIS ROUND.
Condition 3 needs 'the last Rafe-approved capture of the same surface'. THE RECORD DOES NOT
CONTAIN ONE. No floor capture in this session has been approved outright: the verdicts run
'not wowed, impressed, close', 'closer, legitimately impressed, one axis remains', 'passed
in kind', and a run of FAILs. Each praised something and culled something.
Picking one myself would be choosing the baseline my own work is judged against, which is
exactly the conflict the comparative seat exists to remove. So it stays null and the gate
stays shut until Rafe names it.
The candidates, with what he actually said:
scene_ashlar_r9   'not wowed, impressed, close' — cracks excellent, colouring good
scene_ashlar_r13  'closer, legitimately impressed' — texture passed and frozen
r24_onroute@8640780f  'the keyline fix holds' — the lane was the cull, not the masonry

ruled_fixes.rule: wear modulates the same stones; the lane at 0.6
the travel axis is per pixel, never per tile
the per-tile channel flag does not apply under a route
a joint level with its stone takes the polish
the face/joint delivered specular ratio is capped
the lane's shoulder frays; nothing is staged
the sheltered joint draws its depth from a distribution
§13.10 — instruments derive ground truth from the engine's probes
seat positions are relative to the figure, in tiles
an early exit in the plant run is red, never quiet
candidate transcripts are withheld until the plant clears
